name: groundwork-rag
description: Ask questions over your documents and get answers you can verify: hybrid retrieval (pgvector + Postgres full-text, fused with RRF), native Claude citations, local-first embeddings.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.demo: npm run seed && npm run build && npm start
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
